label: TRANSFER_1 at simple roots, from own-nature carriage REQUIRES_LACK_1 and realization (inference)
rule: At a simple root every determination is realized by the one constituent, so carriage by some determination is carriage by one the seat realizes
meaning: Fix an actual root r, a condition C seated in a real constituent k of r, and an admissible q containing r's determinations in which no determination realized by k requires, as such, the lack of members of q. Every determination t of r is realized by some real constituent (REAL), which simplicity identifies with k; so no determination of r requires such a lack, and own-nature carriage gives C at q. With ownCarriageFromUnity: under simplicity, SEAT, REAL and ESSE, TRANSFER_1 and own-nature carriage as such are equivalent. The unity argument therefore relocates carriage into the transfer premise and gives it no independent warrant at a simple root. The same proof gives TRANSFER_2 from LE_in (Lean-only unityTransferInOfOwnCarriageIn), so the relocation holds in REQUIRES_LACK_2 as well. The main theorem uses no axioms.
